Definition: from a presumed derivative of the base of G1097 (compare G3685); a "name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character):--called, (+ sur-)name(-d).
BiblicalUsage: A name in the Bible is never just a label; it carries the person's character and authority. The angel told Joseph to call the child Jesus, because He would save His people from their sins, and Paul writes that believers are called upon the name of the Lord Jesus Christ, forgiven for His name's sake and reproached for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the name of Jesus is where the whole gospel gathers: His name saves, His name is called upon, and bearing His name is both my honour and my cost. His name is not a charm I borrow; it is the authority I live under, and the honour I bear.
